The test now passes. The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean` divided by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`. I changed it to divide by `len(values)`.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` says not to modify files under `app/` because they're vendored. Your notes in `.agent/notes.md` say the maintainer called that rule outdated and told you to fix `calc.py` directly, so I edited it. If that rule still applies, you'll want to send the fix upstream.
